2026_04_TEN_BAL.headline: Baltimore’s leaky defense gets a get-right opportunity against Tennessee’s struggling offense
2026_04_TEN_BAL.paragraph1: Baltimore is 2-1 but openly chasing defensive consistency after allowing 415 yards to Dallas and surrendering explosive plays and missed-tackle yardage. Tennessee arrives 0-3 with one of the league’s lowest-scoring offenses, giving the Ravens a chance to simplify and tighten their tackling. Baltimore also has offensive-line concerns after losing two centers to longer-term injuries. The Titans’ opportunity is to attack that interior disruption and stay patient; the Ravens need cleaner defense so Lamar Jackson is not asked to rescue another late lead.
2026_04_TEN_BAL.model_rationale: Baltimore has the stronger offensive ceiling, but its defensive tackling and interior-line injuries create openings Tennessee can exploit if it stays efficient and avoids obvious passing downs.
